summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests imzokitug combined with pumitamig and platinum-doublet chemotherapy, compared with pumitamig and platinum-doublet chemotherapy alone, as first-line treatment for locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer. The record says the study drugs are given at specified doses on specified days, but the route and full schedule are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; the record describes the study's purpose as assessing safety, tolerability, and efficacy.

El registro indica que los medicamentos del estudio se administran en dosis y días específicos, pero la vía y el esquema completo no se indican. La medida de resultado principal no se indica; el registro describe el propósito del estudio como la evaluación de la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la eficacia.
who_for: Stage IV non-small cell lung cancer, squamous or non-squamous, or recurrent unresectable disease
No prior systemic anti-cancer therapy for advanced or metastatic disease
Tumor tissue (fresh or archival) obtained within 5 months of consent must be submitted
not_for: Documented actionable genomic alterations with approved first-line targeted therapies
